skins.name: Everything is a Miracle
skins.description: A silky and delicate satin surface, perfectly fitted to the wearer's body shape. Blue-green envelops the body, invoking an ancient charm. After completing the outfit's design, the client draws it into existence, ready-to-wear, with a stroke of the brush.

skins.name: Along the Corridor
skins.description: Made by Lungmen craftsmen from premium Shangshu silk. Elegant and classical patterns with cyan lining make for a dignified outfit.
skins.image: /five-star-skins/Kroos the Keen Glint - Along the Corridor.webp

skins.name: Gourmet
skins.description: FEater's outfit from a bestselling Lungmen foodie film. Incorporates a sporty inner layer and a traditional knotted jacked, once all the rage.

skins.name: Pale Rising Moon
skins.description: Inspired by the outfits Mr. Nothing uses to conceal others, with an improved design. Just as the moon waxes and wanes, some people occasionally decide to break character and act debonair.

skins.name: Serene Day
skins.description: Handmade in Lungmen . The fabric is light and comfortable, using the client's favorite purple color as a base and embellished with dark lines. Casual yet dignified, it is perfect for all sorts of occasions.
